verdicts.title: Multilevel Monte Carlo estimation of the expected value of sample information
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study Monte Carlo estimation of the expected value of sample information (EVSI) which measures the expected benefit of gaining additional information for decision making under uncertainty. EVSI is defined as a nested expectation in which an outer expectation is taken with respect to one random variable $Y$ and an inner conditional expectation with respect to the other random variable $θ$. verdicts.title: Stress-energy Tensor Correlators of a Quantum Field in Euclidean $R^N$ and $AdS^N$ spaces via the generalized zeta-function method
